title: KiCad 6 STM32 PCB Design Full Tutorial - Phil's Lab #65
summary: A 100-minute tutorial from Phil's Lab on designing an STM32-based 'black pill' PCB in KiCad 6. It covers schematic capture, two-layer layout and routing, USB, and sending the board for manufacture and assembly.
why: HN recommends it as a practical way to learn KiCad and PCB design by following one full project.
